backend.description: sandbox: the separate container. local: inside the daemon's container, without isolation.

timeoutSec.description: Default and maximum time per command; the whole process group is killed after it.

maxOutputKb.description: Output returned to the model (stdout and stderr together); the middle of longer output is cut.

shell.description: Shell that runs the command with -c (backend local only; default /bin/sh).

env.description: Extra environment variables for commands (plain values; secrets are never passed).

logMb.description: Log kept per job; older output is dropped.
